units: plan coordinates in metres; proposed dimensions, not measured gameplay

families.title: 01 / CORRIDORS
families.captionA: Glossy capsule cuts turn the route around a clear bypass.
families.captionB: Staggered planes break the view before the next encounter.
notes: L / LEGAL: capsule niche or large flush L.
4 m main routes; 2 m bypass; 4-8 m exposed views.
1.1 m counter; 4.3 m solid returns stop sightlines.
A and B share the loop; B staggers the returns.

families.title: 02 / JUNCTIONS + DOORS
families.captionA: A high sky lens and unlike corner treatments identify each branch.
families.captionB: Offset exits turn a crossfire junction into short, readable peeks.
notes: R / REVIEW: sky lens in A; cropped flush R in B.
4 m approach; 2 m offset exits; 4-8 m views.
Doors remain 1.2 x 2.4 m; cover is 1.1 m.
Dashed T cap = A; B opens it and offsets exits.

families.title: 03 / ROOMS + COVER
families.captionA: A solid capsule counter anchors a compact room with two exits.
families.captionB: One low monolith and one full-height return make the office abstract.
notes: C / CLAIMS: high frosted capsule or flush C field.
8 x 8 m room; 2 m outer loop; 4-8 m views.
Cover: A 2 x 1 x 1.1 m; B 4 x 1 x 1.1 m.
One plan, alternate counter lengths; 1.2 m doors.

families.title: 04 / ATRIUM + VERTICAL
families.captionA: The retained spiral and clear balconies form a legible arrival hub.
families.captionB: A broad stair, short ramp and drop reconnect the fight at two levels.
notes: H / HEARINGS: capsule core or high open-square graphic.
16 x 16 m hub; 4.5 m upper deck; 8-12 m views.
B: 2 m stair; 2 x 4 m ramp to a 1 m shelf.
Circle = A spiral option; right bay = B stair option.

families.title: 05 / GLASS WALLS
families.captionA: High frosted lintels name the room above almost-clear combat glass.
families.captionB: Solid, visible-but-closed and cleared-open bays give three route reads.
notes: A / ARCHIVE: high lintel or large flush terminal A.
2 m bypass; 4-8 m views; solid returns interrupt.
Frost only above 2.1 m or below 0.45 m.
Open gap = cleared break state; shooting rules stay with its owner.
